name: TP
meaning: Throttle valve position (from TP sensors, ADC ch0B/ch2C)

name: APS
meaning: Accelerator (grip) position (from APS sensors, ADC ch0F/ch2B)

name: AP
meaning: Barometric/atmospheric pressure (AP sensor, ADC ch30) - used as the reference in calculated load and vacuum

name: IAP
meaning: Intake manifold pressure (IAP sensor, ADC ch31)

name: Temp ch00
meaning: Temperature input ADC ch00 - DISABLED in this calibration (option 0x18F18A=0, fixed 255)

name: IAT
meaning: Intake air temperature (ADC ch02, 8-bit) - used in calculated-load density correction

name: Gear
meaning: Gear position bitmask (1=N, 2=1st ... 0x40=6th) from GP sensor ADC ch2E

name: Lean
meaning: Lean (bank) angle magnitude from IMU (0x8000 = upright)

name: Slip
meaning: Wheel-slip style ratio (front/rear speed based, 0x8000 = 0) - traction control

name: GP raw
meaning: Gear position sensor raw ADC ch2E

name: AP raw
meaning: Atmospheric pressure sensor raw ADC ch30

name: IAP raw
meaning: Intake pressure sensor raw ADC ch31

name: Vbatt raw
meaning: Battery voltage raw ADC ch03 (OBD PID 0x42 source)
